svg.title: DOODI database entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Five tables and all 31 columns: users, movies, reviews, watchlists and sessions. Users and movies each have zero or many reviews and watchlist entries. Users have zero or many sessions. Each child references exactly one parent.
svg.text: Movie review platform | MySQL + Prisma | 5 tables / 5 relationships
Actual database names. Each relationship connects one parent to zero or more child rows.
Movie deletion through the API is soft.
Foreign keys cascade on hard deletion.
Source: prisma/schema.prisma + SQL migrations | 31 columns | Verified 20 Oct 2026
